rv.q: Running through Dec. 15, “Macbeth” is a solid, sometimes exceptional, production of one of Shakespeare’s greatest plays.
It’s an immersive and unforgettable experience that cements Invictus Theatre’s place among the top-tier Chicago theatre companies.
This production of Macbeth is incredibly enjoyable.
In all, this is a good production that tells a tale about egomania, tyranny, and deviousness.

cn.t: Invictus Theatre's bold, atmospheric production brings raw intensity to Shakespeare's tragedy, with critics praising strong performances and eerie supernatural elements that create a potent, visceral experience.
